title: Mehta 9-Step Multi-Layer Mundane Prediction Scheme
description: The foundational 9-step evaluation protocol for annual mundane prediction. Each step is a separate chart/analysis layer; later steps refine earlier ones. Outputs from all 9 steps are synthesized for the final forecast. The protocol MUST be run in order — later steps depend on earlier baselines.

step_1.name: Foundation Horoscope
step_1.description: National DNA chart — cast for the moment of nation's independence/founding.
step_1.purpose: Establishes the nation's permanent planetary strengths, weaknesses, and karmic patterns.
step_1.repeat: Once per nation — does not change year to year.

step_2.name: New Year Chart (Chaitra Shukla Pratipada)
step_2.description: Annual Hindu New Year chart cast for each country's capital.
step_2.purpose: Sets the annual theme — Celestial Cabinet is appointed from this chart.
step_2.repeat: Annually (Chaitra Shukla Pratipada = first day of Hindu new year).

step_3.name: Surya Veedhi (Sun Transit Path)
step_3.description: Sun's transit through the 12 signs tracked with weekday-ingress filters.
step_3.purpose: Monthly commodity and weather triggers (Sankranti logic).
step_3.repeat: 12 times per year (once per solar ingress).

step_4.name: Paksha Charts (Fortnight Charts)
step_4.description: New Moon and Full Moon charts cast for each fortnight.
step_4.purpose: 14-day event windows — assassination, flood, drought triggers.

step_5.name: Eclipses
step_5.description: Solar and Lunar eclipse charts analyzed by decanate and house.
step_5.purpose: Major long-duration triggers (eclipse effects last 3–36 months).

step_6.name: Standard Planetary Transits
step_6.description: Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Rahu/Ketu sign changes tracked.

step_7.name: Specialized Chakras
step_7.description: Koorma, Sanghatta, Sarvatobhadra, Simhasan Chakras applied.

step_8.name: Occasional Conjunctions
step_8.purpose: Historical mega-events — wars, regime changes, generational shifts.
step_8.repeat: Per occurrence (Saturn-Mars every 2 years; Jupiter-Saturn every 20 years).

step_9.name: Annual Varshaphala (Foundation Chart Dasha)
step_9.description: 5-Year Compressed Vimshottari Dasha applied to the national foundation chart.
step_9.purpose: Identifies the 'policy lifespan' — which sub-period drives current events.

title: Gaur Samvat Stambha — 4 Pillar Seasonal Assessment
description: Stambha = pillar/column. 4 pillars assess Water, Grain/Grass, Wind, and Food conditions for the year. Each pillar is calculated from the proportional duration of Pratipada (first lunar day) spent in each season/sign at year start. High % in a pillar = abundance; Low % = scarcity.

interpretation.low_jal: Drought year — water scarcity in arid zones
interpretation.high_anna: Food surplus — prices low, public contentment
interpretation.low_anna: Food scarcity — prices high, social unrest risk

title: Gaur Sanghatta Chakra — Rashi Vedha (Obstruction) Vector Matrix
description: Each Rashi has 3 Vedha vectors: front (opposite), left flank, right flank. A malefic transiting a Vedha rashi of another malefic creates the 'Sanghatta' (collision/conflict). When Saturn + Mars + Rahu meet on this grid = Destruction Scheme (war prerequisite). See interpretation_rules for predictive rules.

spec_data.vedha_logic: Vedha = obstruction. A planet in position X creates Vedha pressure on the three positions listed as its front, left, and right Vedha targets. When two malefics form mutual Vedha = conflict indicator. Three malefics (Saturn + Mars + Rahu) in mutual Vedha = Destruction Scheme.

destruction_scheme.trigger: Saturn AND Mars AND Rahu all meet on the Sanghatta grid
destruction_scheme.validation: Confirmed in multiple historical war outbreaks

rohini_gate.rule: Saturn or malefics in Rohini aspected by Mars = critical war/famine threshold

title: Mehta Simhasan Chakra — 5-Level Nakshatra Authority Grid
description: Maps all 27 Nakshatras to 5 levels of authority in the national chart. Used to assess: (1) which 'layer' of authority is activated when a planet transits a nakshatra; (2) oath-taking ceremony vetting — Moon or Lagna lord in high-authority nakshatra = strong governance. Level 5 (Simhasan) = peak authority; Level 1 (Aadhaar) = public/mass foundation.

5_simhasan_throne.label: Simhasan (Throne) — Peak Authority
5_simhasan_throne.result: Maximum authority; dominant martial leadership; peak governance power

4_simha_royalty.label: Simha (Royal Cabinet) — Executive Power
4_simha_royalty.result: Martial leadership; decisive executive action; cabinet-level authority

3_patta_ministers.label: Patta (Council of Ministers) — Policy Strength
3_patta_ministers.result: Policy coherence; ministerial support; judicial authority

2_aasan_bureaucracy.label: Aasan (Bureaucracy) — Administrative Support
2_aasan_bureaucracy.result: Civil service stability; administrative backing for the leader

1_aadhaar_public.label: Aadhaar (Public Foundation) — Mass Base
1_aadhaar_public.result: Public mood indicator; mass popular support or agitation

usage_notes: Oath chart vetting: Moon in Simhasan/Simha level = strong leadership mandate
Oath chart: Moon in Aadhaar level = government derives strength from public pressure (populist)
War forecast: Moon + Mars in Simha Nadi = military king — leads nation into conflict
Opposition assessment: Opponent with Moon in Simhasan vs. Moon in Aadhaar = challenger wins

title: Mehta 5-Year Compressed Vimshottari Dasha for Governance
description: Compresses the standard 120-year Vimshottari Dasha into a 5-year government mandate. Used to time policy shifts, leadership crises, and administrative collapses within a single parliamentary term. Formula: Compressed_days = (Vimshottari_years × 5 × 365) / 120

spec_data.starting_planet: Planet at Lagna lord at oath-taking — determines first sub-period
usage_examples: Mars sub-period (106 days): peak military assertion, border tension
Saturn sub-period (289 days): agricultural stress, labour unrest, austerity
Jupiter sub-period (244 days): policy expansion, judicial activity, education reform
Venus sub-period (304 days): cultural growth, diplomatic initiatives, luxury spending
Sun sub-period (91 days): leadership assertion, executive decisions, foreign policy

varshaphala_ratio.description: Annual Varshaphala dasha uses same planets but 1-year compression

title: Gaur Ch 10: Sun Sankranti Weekday Ingress Modifier Matrix
description: The day-of-week on which the Sun enters a new sign modifies the commodity price signals for the entire month. Overrides the base sign commodity matrix when weekday pattern is strong. Applies to all 12 ingresses (Sankrantis). Muhurti duration also modifies: 45-muhurti ingress = maximum benefic (cheap grains).

general_muhurti_rule.45_muhurti: Maximum benefic ingress — good rainfall and cheap grains assured even in dry seasons
general_muhurti_rule.30_muhurti: Moderate benefic — average yield; prices stable
general_muhurti_rule.15_muhurti: Weak ingress — prices volatile; watch for weather disruption

spec_data.retrograde_override: If Saturn is retrograde at the time of any Sankranti, the weekday modifier is overridden and the result defaults to: 'Prices volatile; agricultural instability.'

title: Gaur Sarvatobhadra Chakra — Vedha-Based Commodity Price Engine
description: The Sarvatobhadra Chakra is an 81-cell grid. Benefic Vedha on a commodity nakshatra = prices DECREASE (oversupply or peace signal). Malefic Vedha = prices INCREASE (scarcity or conflict signal). Mercury's commodity result is determined by its conjunction partner (not its own quality).

core_rules.benefic_vedha: Benefic planet's Vedha on commodity nakshatra → price DECREASES (supply up / demand satisfied)
core_rules.malefic_vedha: Malefic planet's Vedha on commodity nakshatra → price INCREASES (scarcity / tension signal)
core_rules.mercury_rule: Mercury adopts the commodity result of whichever planet it is conjunct — benefic partner = cheap; malefic partner = expensive

yield_price_inverse.rule: High agricultural yield → prices LOW; Low agricultural yield → prices HIGH
yield_price_inverse.mechanism: Oversupply in good yield years depresses prices; scarcity in poor years inflates them
yield_price_inverse.application: Always check yield forecast before commodity price forecast — they are inversely correlated

grid_structure.central_cell: Nakshatra of the commodity or subject in question
grid_structure.vedha_calc: Planets cast Vedha shadows across the grid based on their sign position
